UPDATE import_jobs
         SET processed = processed + 1,
             imported = imported + $2,
             skipped = skipped + $3,
             skips = CASE WHEN $4::jsonb IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(skips) >= $5 THEN skips
                          ELSE skips || jsonb_build_array($4::jsonb) END
         WHERE id = $1
